note.title: Limiting factors and graphs
note.overview: The factor in shortest supply limits photosynthesis. Graph shape changes when the limiting factor changes or enzymes denature.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for limiting factors and graphs.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Increasing light or carbon dioxide increases rate only while that factor is limiting.
A plateau means another factor is limiting.
Temperature raises rate to an optimum, then high temperature lowers it because enzymes denature.

a factor that raises photosynthesis rate at low levels until another factor limits it
a reactant factor that can limit photosynthesis even in warm bright conditions
a factor affecting enzyme-controlled photosynthesis, with an optimum and denaturation at high values
a level part of a graph showing that increasing the x-variable no longer raises the rate
